definitions.meaning: An ell-measure, the length of an ell, two feet?

quotations.old_english: Ðæt fær gewyrc fíftiges wíd, þrittiges heáh, þreó hund lang elngemeta
quotations.english: make the vessel fifty wide, thirty high, three hundred long, of ell measures

source_text: eln-gemet, es; n. An ell-measure, the length of an ell, two feet? c&u-short;b&i-short;t&a-long;lis mensura, ulnae mens&u-long;ra :-- Ðæt fær gewyrc fíftiges wíd, þrittiges heáh, þreó hund lang elngemeta make the vessel fifty wide, thirty high, three hundred long, of ell measures, Cd. 65; Th. 79, 10; Gen. 1309. v. eln I. and III.
